conventions.test1_entry: adjusted close on sell date (next trading day if not a trading day); exit close +k trading days
conventions.test2_entry: signal on close t; entry close t+1; exit close t+1+k; first-occurrence = no same signal in prior 60 trading days
conventions.sharpe: pair-short P&L per event, mean/std * sqrt(252/k); events overlap in time -> rough
conventions.benchmark_map: SEMI_AI (trade_ledger.py) + extra semis -> SMH; software set -> IGV; else SPY (test1 uses SMH/SPY only per task)
